name: Zul'Gurub: Jeklik calls six bats every 30 s in both forms, and Crazed Bat Riders on Mythic
contract: On live Jeklik (14517) brings six Bloodseeker Bats (11368) every 30 s in her troll and her bat form, and in
her bat form on Mythic and Ascended a Crazed Bat Rider (14914) on a Frenzied Bloodseeker Bat (14965) every
30 s, the first 6 s in, in place of stock's two Gurubashi Bat Riders (14750) (round-5 tester and live logs).
Our Jeklik called bats only as a troll, once a minute, and on Mythic a lone frenzied bat without its rider.
The waves come 52 s into the fight and every 30 s after. The pair circles out of reach while the rider
throws Liquid Fire, until the bat dives 16-56 s after it came and the rider can be struck. A Mythic Jeklik
is wounded into her bat form after landing; a Normal Jeklik stays a troll for two waves, then is wounded
into her bat form for a third, and calls no Crazed Bat Rider. Bats fight the heroes, who do not strike back,
so every wave stays; liquid fire is read from the heroes' own combat log, and the dive from the bat's Frenzy.
Summoned beside a hero, Jeklik engages in the same tick as her Reset casts Green Channeling (13540). The
channel never expires and she does nothing while she casts, so her engage interrupts it; before, it lasted
until a damaging swing landed, and a hero who kept missing faced an idle Jeklik that called no wave. A
